contract.scope: repository.Read; current configured folder members, no template administration
contract.field_semantics: Collection projections may return first value only; ListFields supplies assigned field objects, unformatted values by default. Missing hasMoreValues never becomes complete.

execution.command: pytest tests/test_repository_fields.py tests/test_repository_search.py tests/test_repository_async_export.py tests/test_repository_export_variants.py tests/test_repository_content.py tests/test_repository_text.py tests/test_repository_fetch.py tests/test_repository_discovery.py tests/test_capabilities.py -q
scope: opt-in assigned multivalue fields on detail, discovery and native search; saved capture never initiates field network
raw supplementary bytes, unknown/null/empty/absent values, per-field capture/citation provenance
same-entry nextLinks, duplicates/counts, malformed/unknown completeness, token echo and HTTP/transport failures
page/field-count/byte/deadline bounds, cancellation and combined field/text budget
metadata/obtained fields retained on partial failure; later discovery failure retains supplemental captures
actual SQLite import/reopen/search and ZIP import/export preserve fields and captures
normalized change detection preserves source identity; existing read/search/export regressions

limitations: Synthetic provider transport only; no actual provider request or mutation
Opt-in repository_include_fields boolean; default reads preserve existing network scope
Current-folder membership comes from the scoped metadata/list/search response; no atomic snapshot
hasMoreValues true/missing, truncation and failures are partial rather than whole-field completion
Field values are repository metadata, not inferred meeting dates or governing bodies
No field writes, template administration, new provider/parser registration or whole-provider acceptance
